method.runtime: Offline JavaScript only; no original-runtime execution or native debugger use.
method.inputStateReconstruction: Each case gets a fresh original state from MAKE-RANDOM-STATE-FROM-SEED(seed); JavaScript uses a fresh Allegro501Random(seed) at offset zero. Captured RAN returns and point results are comparison targets only, never inputs to state reconstruction.
method.numericTypeHandling: Source probe literals are retained verbatim, including s0/d0. Lisp single-float report values without a suffix are compared after Math.fround; double-float values retain binary64 precision. Negative-zero source/report disagreement is unclassified.
method.distanceCallHandling: The portable evidence stores RAN and XYDIST calls in separate arrays. This comparison checks the full RAN sequence and preserves the XYDIST records, but the split arrays do not preserve or establish shared RAN/XYDIST event interleaving.
method.representabilityRule: Strict replay is limited to FDEX=0, TDEX=point-count-1, FROM=0, TO=1, where the closed-list API input shape applies. No range rows are sliced, rotated, or reversed.

limitations: The 30 strict comparisons cover only canonical closed-list calls with source/report input agreement; they do not establish a complete FREE-PATH contract.
Eight noncanonical FDEX/TDEX/FROM/TO cases remain unclassified because the current JavaScript API cannot accept those index values; no index mapping is inferred.
The two negative-zero rows remain unclassified because the probe source contains -0.0d0 while the captured CASE header records +0.0d0.
This comparison does not establish natural caller policy, scene-generation parity, or whole-painting parity.
